description: Source code implementing real-time OpenAI LLM context and aggregator classes, including context management, message conversion, and frame processing for a conversational AI system.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext
classes.description: Extends OpenAILLMContext to support real-time session management, message conversion, and session instructions handling.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeUserContextAggregator
classes.description: Handles user input frames, updates context with real-time message frames, and manages aggregation logic.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: Processes assistant output frames, filters duplicate text frames, and manages function call result frames.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext with optional messages and tools, and sets up local session variables.

methods.name: __setup_local
methods.description: Sets internal flags and session instructions to default values.

methods.name: upgrade_to_realtime
methods.description: Converts a standard OpenAILLMContext into a realtime context by changing its class and initializing session variables.

methods.name: from_standard_message
methods.description: Converts a standard message dict into a ConversationItem for realtime API, handling user and assistant roles.

methods.name: get_messages_for_initializing_history
methods.description: Prepares conversation history for session initialization, packing messages into a single user message if needed.

methods.name: add_user_content_item_as_message
methods.description: Adds a user content item as a message to the context.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, handling realtime-specific message update frames and tool setting frames.

methods.name: push_aggregation
methods.description: Placeholder for pushing user input aggregation; currently ignores input.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles function call result frames and pushes a special frame to notify the realtime service.
